name: Master Strategy Deck Building Set (Gardevoir ex)

releases.name: Master Strategy Deck Building Set (Gardevoir ex)

description.text: The Master Strategy Deck Building Set (大师战略卡组构筑套装) Gardevoir ex is a box for players who want to start battling quickly and keep improving a deck, one of three released on 16 January 2026 with the Charizard ex, Gardevoir ex and Miraidon ex decks. It holds a ready-built 60-card Gardevoir ex deck, with Gardevoir ex, Drifloon and Radiant Greninja among its Pokémon and Iono, Buddy-Buddy Poffin and Earthen Vessel among its Trainers. Pokémon China pitched it at players who like careful plans and long-range tactics to control the game. With it come a sheet on how the deck plays, a 15-card modification pack and a guide to changing the deck, four 20-card Blade Awakening packs to change it further, a set of 64 card sleeves in one of eight designs at random, a Gardevoir deck box with two dividers, a coin die, six metal damage-counter dice and an acrylic VSTAR marker and Poison and Burn markers. Its cards are numbered out of 33.

sources.title: Pokémon China: The Master Strategy Deck Building Sets: Charizard ex, Gardevoir ex and Miraidon ex (25 December 2025)
